locator: I q.2 a.3 co., tertia via: Si igitur omnia sunt possibilia non esse, aliquando nihil fuit in rebus
interpretation: The step itself, as a conditional: if every being can not-be, at some past time nothing was. 'Fuit' is read as past time. Derived as an intermediate conclusion in AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-TERTIA-VIA-NECESSARY-BEING from plenitude, an infinite past and collective possibility.
